summary: INLIF Limited, a Cayman-incorporated, Nasdaq-listed (INLF) maker of injection molding machine manipulator arms operating through PRC entity Ewatt Robot Equipment, filed a Form 6-K on September 9, 2026 attaching a press release disclosing that its Extraordinary General Meeting, convened September 8, 2026 at 9:30 a.m. ET at the principal office, was adjourned for lack of quorum. Under the amended and restated memorandum and articles, quorum requires holders of at least one-third of voting ordinary shares, Class A and Class B counted together; the inspector confirmed insufficient in-person and proxy representation. The meeting reconvenes September 15, 2026 at 9:30 a.m. ET at the same location.
